result.summary: The 2022 page drops the 2020 Fellows framing about helping clients transform and being the 'responsible—and dependable—steward of technology' and adds a new 2021 Fellows message stressing 'pre-eminent technical honor' and 'technical achievements'. It also reframes Services as Consulting, 'turn ideas into actions', and adds a 2-nanometer chip innovation item with 'greener data centers'. Overall emphasis shifts toward innovation and consulting.</summary>
